gitCommit.subject: feat(ci): run tests by tag, and a ready nightly schedule (#43)
gitCommit.body:
feat(ci): run tests by tag, and a ready nightly schedule (#43)

- Every test has one suite tag (@smoke, @regression, @links) on its
  describe, plus area tags (@errors, @forms, @a11y, @auth). The smoke tests'
  test-level @smoke moves to their describe.
- CI's smoke and functional jobs, and test:smoke, test:regression and
  test:a11y, select by tag: a new spec needs no workflow edit.
- scripts/tag-check.js, run by template-check: one suite tag that fits its
  file, and no tag, title, describe, path or project name that would fool
  --grep. Unit tests run on a trimmed real --list report.
- qa-test.yml: a commented-out nightly schedule, with the dashboard's and
  link checker's schedule conditions and the production option in comments.
- Docs: the handbook (tags, run by tag, smoke by tag, routine), README,
  /new-engagement step 5 (tags, the schedule hand-off), site-config.md,
  testing.md, the operators guide, the PR template; coverage map
  regenerated.
